https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/politics/2.title: JUST STOP IT Ed Miliband poses for selfie with eco yobs’ donor who brought misery to thousands of hard-working Brits
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/politics/2.text:
SHADOW Net Zero Secretary Ed Miliband last night stopped for a chat and selfies with Just Stop Oil bankroller Dale Vince.
The green team met inside the Pullman Hotel in Liverpool, where Labour Conference is taking place - the day Mr Vince announced he would no longer funnel cash to the eco-zealots.
Mr Miliband and the millionaire were all smiles as they conversed for around ten minutes with a small group of conference delegates.
They then wrapped their arms around each other and snapped some selfies, despite Sir Keir Starmer having previously trashed Just Stop Oil as "chaos" mongers.
Yesterday Mr Vince declared he'd stop bankrolling the eco-zealots because future disruption from the group would be "counterproductive".
The founder of green company Ecotricity, who is also a major Labour donor, added that mass disruption would "feed the Tories' culture-war narrative".
He said: "In order to 'just stop oil', first we need to just stop the Tories."
Mr Vince has been a passionate backer of Just Stop Oil since the group was first formed in February 2022.
He's given them a whopping £340,000.
And Mr Vince's green energy company Ecotricity has donated more than £1.4m to Labour since 2014.
Sir Keir has tried to distance himself and Labour from JSO, calling their demands “contemptible”.
Labour and Mr Vince have been approached for comment.

image.caption: Ed Miliband and Just Stop Oil donor Dale Vince posed for a selfie inside the Pullman Hotel where Labour Party conference is taking place
Mr Vince has donated hundreds of thousands to Just Stop Oil, but last night announced intentions to stop paying the group so he can focus on "just stopping the Tories" instead

https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24590226/j.title: JUST STOP IT Just Stop Oil poster girl vows to be arrested seven times over the next few weeks ahead of new wave of disruption
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24590226/j.subtitle: Phoebe Plummer reckons the public will soon be fully onside with the controversial protest group
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24590226/j.text:
A JUST Stop Oil poster girl has vowed to be arrested seven times and wants to be jailed again.
Pink-haired leader Phoebe Plummer, 22, said she is “going for at least five arrests and hoping for six or seven over three weeks.”
Just Stop Oil is due to launch another wave of protests this week.
And Ms Plummer reckons weak protest laws mean other group members who stop traffic with slow marches can keep getting away with just a slap on the wrist.
She told an undercover reporter: “There’s no risk of custodial time. The harshest punishment is a small fine. We need to grab this opportunity while we have it and it’s such a minor offence.”
She has already been jailed several times for protests and threw a tin of soup over a Van Gogh painting at the National Gallery, London, last year.
The activist described dangerous action on the M25 which police chiefs said had put lives at risk as “f*** brilliant” - but said the focus for the foreseeable future was slow marching and targeting events.
She said: “Slow marching because it’s more entry-level for people. My first action was smashing up petrol stations.
“It was f**g brilliant what we did on the M25, shutting it down for four days.
“I was part of that. I went to prison for that last year.”
Plummer even reckoned the public would soon be fully onside with the group.
She added that the plan was “goading the government”.
She said: “It then puts them into a real political crisis where the crackdown on us even harder in which case they are already breaching my human rights conventions and if they make marching illegal that is a serious attack on fundamental human rights."
She said other big events were being targeted as well.
She said: “I’m excited. I am excited to go out and get arrested.
“We will continue to do cultural actions. Cultural actions like the snooker and disrupting Les Miserables.”
Another activist said: “We want to fill the prisons. It’s going to be amazing.”

image.caption: Just Stop Oil leader Phoebe Plummer wants to be jailed for her cause

https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24433600/g.title: PROTEST ARREST Eco-warrior Greta Thunberg arrested after joining protest outside conference in London
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24433600/g.text:
THIS is the moment Greta Thunberg was hauled away by cops after she was arrested at a protest today.
The eco-warrior had joined the demonstration at the five-star InterContinental Park Lane.
She was pictured being led by away by Met Police officers following the protest against the Energy Intelligence Forum (EIF).
The meeting, which brings together fossil fuel executives and government ministers, has been branded the "the Oscars of oil".
Thunberg and dozens of other eco-zealots chanted "oily money out" and attempted to block access to the luxury hotel.
Two Greenpeace eco-warriors abseiled down from the roof to unfurl a giant banner reading "Make Big Oil Pay".
Swedish activist Thunberg was detained with around ten other activists before being driven away in a police car.
The Met confirmed six people were initially arrested on suspicion of obstructing a highway during the protest.
A further 14 were detained on suspicion of disrupting public order, and one other person was arrested for criminal damage.

image.caption: Greta Thunberg was arrested at a climate protest today
Thunberg joined protesters in a march against the Energy Intelligence Forum
She was detained along with a number of other activists

https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/politics/2.title: BIG SWING Labour WINS crunch by-elections in Tamworth and Mid Bedfordshire in double blow for Rishi Sunak
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/politics/2.text:
LABOUR has dealt a double blow to Rishi Sunak by winning TWO crunch by-elections.
Sarah Edwards defeated Conservative Andrew Cooper by 1,316 votes in Tamworth - overturning a huge 19,600 majority.
Meanwhile in Mid Bedfordshire, Labour's Alistair Strathern beat Local Police and Crime Commissioner Festus Akinbusoye to overturn former minister Nadine Dorries' 24,000 majority.
Tories were bracing for crushing blows earlier, with Mr Cooper defending a near-20,000 majority won by Chris Pincher who was kicked out of the Commons following a groping scandal.
Tamworth's new MP Ms Edwards said: "Tonight the people of Tamworth have voted for Labour's positive vision and a fresh start.
"They've sent a clear message to Rishi Sunak and the Conservatives that they have had enough of this failed Government, which has crashed the economy and destroyed our public services.
"The people of Tamworth have made it clear. It's time for change."
She also called on the PM to call a general election, saying: "My message to the Prime Minister is get in your government car, drive to Buckingham Palace, do the decent thing and call a general election."
Responding to the Tamworth defeat, a Conservative spokesman said: "This is a difficult result on much-reduced turnout.
"But it's important to see it in context. The government of the day rarely wins by-elections and there were specific reasons around the nature of the departure of the previous MP.
"It's disappointing that Andy Cooper has not won, he has lived there his whole life and knows the issues local people are facing.
"He will continue to fight for the people of Tamworth in his role as a local councillor."
After a final weekend of campaigning, even the PM's most loyal backers branded both seats "tough" and "dire".
Sir Keir Starmer said this morning: "Polls are now open in Tamworth and Mid Bedfordshire.
"Today, vote for change. Vote to get Britain’s future back.  Vote Labour."
Last night Mr Sunak refused to condemn his Tamworth candidate, Mr Cooper, for suggesting out-of-work parents who cannot afford to feed kids should “f*** off”.
The wannabe MP has been slammed for posting a “foul-mouthed” diagram on Facebook.
It suggested those who are out of work, pay for "TV Sky/BT/etc", or "have a phone contract + £30" should "f*** off" rather than seek help.
Labour's candidate in Mid Beds was similarly slammed after The Sun unmasked him as a Greenpeace zealot.
Strathern, 33, posed as a zombie for an eco stunt.
His partner Megan Corton-Scott works as a political officer for Greenpeace.

The couple dressed as zombies ­outside the Home Office for one of the group’s stunts last November.
Mr Strathern was also pictured outside Parliament protesting against laws clamping down on Just Stop Oil and Extinction Rebellion disruption.

image.caption: Candidate Sarah Edwards overturned a Conservative majority
Ms Edwards said 'it's time for change'
Alistair Strathern is Mid Bedfordshire's new MP
The Sun unmasked Alistair Strathern as a Greenpeace zealot

https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24475183/t.title: GHOUL 'GOT LUCKY' Tories hit out at election of eco zombie Alistair Strathern to Mid Bedfordshire seat
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24475183/t.text:
TORIES last night hit out at the election of eco-zombie Alistair Strathern.
The Labour candidate, 33, won the Mid Bedfordshire seat on Thursday.
Last year he posed as a zombie for an eco stunt outside the Home Office.
Images show him as a ghoul with face paint including blood dripping from his mouth.
The protest was against new laws that curb extreme protests by environmental activist groups.
The Sun revealed the shocking image just days after Rishi Sunak’s constituency home in North Yorkshire saw activists climb up the property.
One Tory MP said: “He may have got in this time but with a majority just over 1,000 we will target him next time.
“He got lucky on a low turnout but will struggle at the general election.
“A large proportion of voters don’t like the tactics of climate groups such as Greenpeace.”
The Oxford University graduate, 33, worked for the Bank of England advising them on climate matters.
Strathern won the seat from Nadine Dorries with a swing from Tory to Labour of 20.5 per cent overturning a majority of 24,664.
Sir Keir Starmer faced calls to ditch Strathern as a candidate after the stunt was made public but decided to stick with him.

image.caption: Alistair Strathern, who won the Mid-Bedfordshire seat on Thursday, dressed as a ghoul in part of a zombie-themed Greenpeace protest in August

https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24526038/j.title: JUST PATHETIC Mindless Just Stop Oil vandals target Wellington war memorial with spray paint
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24526038/j.subtitle: The eco-yobs have bragged about their plans and are vowing action for 'weeks'
https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/24526038/j.text:
JUST Stop Oil vandals spray-painted one of the country’s best-known war memorials.
But the 10.15am attack on the Wellington Arch failed to stop the King’s Life Guard marching on horseback through the 200-year-old landmark.
Three protesters were arrested after setting off orange flares and using fire extinguishers to spray orange paint on the arch.
They also held up banners next to the Grade I-listed Arch near Buckingham Palace.
Just Stop Oil said on its Twitter/X account it was protesting against the awarding of fossil fuel licences.
The group wrote: “What use is art when droughts and wildfires ravage our green and pleasant land.”
Activist Joe Hogan, 40, from Hertfordshire, added: “Traditional, managed, sanitised forms of protest have done nothing; the only way forward is through sustained, disruptive civil resistance.”
A council worker was later seen removing the paint.
JSO has been bragging about plans for a “slow march in London on an unprecedented scale” for three weeks from this Sunday.
Its latest stunt comes despite several activists facing court this week.
On Tuesday, retired teacher Gaie Delap, 76, appeared in the High Court to face claims she climbed on to a motorway gantry last November.
The gran, from Bristol, is one of 12 JSO protesters accused of breaching a court injunction aimed at restricting protest on the M25 and causing disruption.
Several junctions across Surrey, London, Essex and Kent were affected.
Ms Delap told Mr Justice Soole that her “heart was breaking” for the future of her six grandchildren.
Lawyers for National Highways say the protesters caused considerable delays and were in contempt of court.
Ms Delap and other defendants said they were unaware an injunction was in place and apologised.
The hearing is expected to last until the end of this week.
Also on Tuesday, three JSO supporters were avoided jail when sentenced to 12-month community orders with 60 hours’ unpaid work for invading the field during an Ashes Test at Lord’s cricket ground.
Judit Murray, 69, Daniel Knorr, 21, and Jacob Bourne, 27, were sentenced at Westminster magistrates’ court for stopping play during the game between England and Australia on June 28.

Last week, JSO blocked a bus transporting asylum seekers to the Bibby Stockholm Barge in Dorset.
The bus driver had to force his way through 23 protesters who walked up and down the road carrying a huge orange banner that read No Prison Ships.

image.caption: Mindless Just Stop Oil vandals targeted the Wellington war memorial with spray paint
The attack on the Wellington Arch failed to stop the King’s Life Guard marching on horseback
